title: a build that names an approved user skill and an approved user MCP server validates; until the launch package exists its launch is rejected
source: intended: JITSO v0.2 plan 2.1 and 2.2 (user allowlist ~/.jitso/jitso.yaml, scoped names in skills_first and mcp)
